name: gap_vwap_momentum_trifecta_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: This combines three independent edges: (1) gap direction bias, (2) VWAP as institutional anchor, and (3) first-hour momentum persistence. When a stock gaps > 0.3%, pulls back to VWAP in the first 45 min, bounces off VWAP, AND the bounce aligns with the gap direction, the trade has three independent supporting factors. Each factor alone is marginal; together they compound into a high-conviction setup. Edge persists because executing a 3-factor strategy requires real-time monitoring that manual traders can't sustain.
stock_filter: top 25 by avg daily turnover, stocks gapping > 0.3%

indicators.name: vwap_touch
indicators.formula: abs(low - vwap) / vwap < 0.001 (gap up) OR abs(high - vwap) / vwap < 0.001 (gap down)

indicators.name: bounce_confirmed
indicators.formula: close > vwap (for gap up) after touching it

long.confirmation: bar closes above VWAP after touching it, in gap direction

short.confirmation: bar closes below VWAP after touching it, in gap direction

exit.signal_exit: close breaks below VWAP against trade direction

filters.trend_filter: gap direction is the trend bias

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — 3-factor confluence is hard to crowd

weaknesses: Very selective — all three factors aligning is rare (maybe 1-2 signals per week)
VWAP pullback may not happen if gap momentum is too strong — missed entries
prior_art: Gap + VWAP + momentum — composite of three well-known single-factor strategies
notes: High-conviction setup. Track separately and consider increasing position size if backtest confirms edge.
